I told Hollis in his thread in #central-team that the site is **Gate 47**, not Dock 23.

- **Why Gate 47:** On 14 October Pree posted Dock 23 in that channel, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning because she'd read the wrong line. Nothing later in the channel changes it. The brain shows the same thing: the Dock 23 note is withdrawn and Gate 47 is the current one.
- **What I checked:** Hollis is a member of #central-team, and both of Pree's messages are posted there, so the answer only uses what he can already see.
